font_scale.description: OpenCV font scale (size multiplier) for HUD text.

text_thickness.description: OpenCV stroke thickness in pixels for HUD text.

line_height_px.description: Vertical spacing between HUD text lines, in pixels.

text_rgb.description: RGB colour (0-255) of the panel value column.

label_rgb.description: RGB colour (0-255) of the panel label column.

accent_rgb.description: RGB colour (0-255) of the live/foreground accent (panel edge bar and radar points).

panel_rgb.description: RGB background colour (0-255) of the HUD panels.

margin_px.description: Margin in pixels between the HUD panels and the frame edge.

column_gap_px.description: Gap in pixels between a panel's label column and its value column.

radar_radius_px.description: Radius of the LIDAR radar, in pixels.

radar_margin_px.description: Margin in pixels between the radar and the frame edge.

radar_bg_rgb.description: RGB background colour (0-255) of the radar.

radar_ring_rgb.description: RGB colour (0-255) of the radar range rings.

radar_crosshair_rgb.description: RGB colour (0-255) of the radar crosshair.

radar_point_rgb.description: RGB colour (0-255) of the plotted LIDAR points.

radar_robot_rgb.description: RGB colour (0-255) of the robot marker at the radar centre.

max_radar_range_m.description: Radar display range in metres; LIDAR points beyond this are not drawn.

logo_size_px.description: Width/height of the team logo watermark, in pixels.

logo_margin_px.description: Margin in pixels between the logo and the frame edge.

join_timeout_sec.description: Seconds VideoRecorder.stop() waits for the writer thread to finalize the video before giving up.

run_path_poll_interval_sec.description: How often VisionNode polls for the run directory to appear, in seconds.

run_path_poll_timeout_sec.description: How long VisionNode polls for the run directory before giving up on recording video, in seconds.
